newsitem.title: UK: Greene King gains after broker "buy" comment.
newsitem.headline: Greene King gains after broker "buy" comment.

text.p: Shares in Greene King Plc rose on Thursday as analysts at BZW repeated a "buy" rating on the brewer, after yesterday's sharp rise in year-end results, dealers said.
Greene King shares were quoted up 17p at 670-1/2 by 0938 GMT, though no volume was recorded.

Sources said BZW viewed Greene King as the best of the UK regional brewing companies and its results showed the company's recent acquisition of theme pub operator the Magic Pub Company to have been "inspired."
Analysts at BZW were not immediately available for comment.
On Wednesday, Greene King posted a rise in pre-tax profit before exceptional items to 36.7 million stg from 24.7 million a year before.

Chief executive Tim Bridge said it had been a "particularly important and successful year for Greene King" and that the integration of Magic Pubs had been achieved smoothly, bringing in the mutual benefits that had been expected.
